summary.text: Dwayne Yunker is a Republican state representative from District 3 who has represented the district since December 27, 2023 and is seeking re-election.
The Josephine County Commission appointed him to the seat on December 27, 2023, to replace Lily Morgan.

paragraphs.text: Dwayne Yunker formerly worked as a real estate agent and as a Grants Pass city councilman.
He is also a former member of the U.S. Navy and Army National Guard.
